answer: Gate full earning behind age that only ripens with continuous presence: an identity climbs from the shale foothills to the earning summit one epoch at a time, and a missed epoch slides it back down the meadow. Time is the one resource a farmer cannot parallelize; minting ten thousand identities at once ages none of them faster, so they all face the same long climb in wall-clock. The honest agent who shows up each epoch reaches the summit once; the farm must sustain every fake, live, across the whole ramp or earn nothing.
